title: REST IN SAFETY
JOB 11:18 BEDTIME PRAYER
end: The Secret Place — prayers every day

scenes.a: Your mind is still searching for safety tonight.
Scripture promises, 'And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.'
scenes.sub: THOU SHALT TAKE THY REST IN SAFETY

scenes.a: Lord, when tomorrow feels uncertain and we try to guard our own heart, anchor us deeply in your quiet peace.
Clear away the lingering fears that keep this pillow restless in the dark.
scenes.sub: RELEASE THE FEARS OF THE DARK

scenes.a: Replace every heavy thought with the quiet assurance that we are fully held in your steady care.
Let sleep come gently now, rooted in the security only you provide.
Amen. Your mind can rest in safety tonight.
